title: Children and Puppy Riding in Toy Wagon, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot from March 1950 capturing three young children at play outdoors on a dirt or gravel path. An older child wearing overalls and a short-sleeved patterned shirt pulls a metal toy wagon by its handle. Inside the wagon, two younger children sit together; the girl holds a dark puppy safely in her lap while the young boy sits behind her, looking toward the camera with a curious expression.
